associations.name: Mojave
associations.period: Nineteenth-century regional expansion described in archive overview; inspected 2026-10-21
associations.evidenceNote: Actual opening geography paragraph identifies Mojave language communities along the Colorado River and explicit nineteenth-century expansion toward Blythe, California, and Ehrenberg, Arizona. This is language-community geography, not a modern jurisdiction or complete homeland. Dated speaker totals were excluded.
